expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: in 2024 retries that drew a fresh idempotency key charged
members twice, which is why every attempt sends the same key.
expectations.evidence: The agent's message only states the general documented risk ('retrying with a fresh key can charge twice if the previous attempt succeeded before timing out') but never mentions the 2024 incident, the 41 members charged twice, or asks before/warns specifically about making this change given that history.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/payments.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/payments.md at step 8; first edit at step 11

expectations.name: 03-acts-on-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent acts on the earlier incident: it leaves the change out and says why, asks first, or makes it while warning, in
its message, the code or the docs, that it brings back members charged twice when a timed-out attempt had already
charged the card, as in 2024.
expectations.evidence: The agent made the change but explicitly warned in its message ('The documented risk remains: retrying with a fresh key can charge twice if the previous attempt succeeded before timing out.') and in the docs ('in 2024 retries that drew a fresh key for each attempt charged 41 members twice. Using a new key on retries retains this risk.'), naming the specific 2024 double-charge harm.
